completion.minimum_dossier: Opportunity Case and company research expose a progressive local employer dossier keyed by the exact job. It shows reviewed official posting status, posting history, pay clarity, application channel, bounded local outcome counts, source dates, freshness, uncertainty, and one safe next action.
completion.privacy: Local observations remain local and are aggregated by exact employer name as counts and latest outcome only. Raw notes, contacts, resumes, protected answers, and unrelated history do not enter the projection. Opening the dossier performs no network request.
completion.trust_boundary: Only exact reviewed Greenhouse and Lever evidence can supply official-source links in the minimum host path. Missing, stale, conflicting, malformed, oversized, or unsupported facts remain explicit or fail closed. Employer identity, safety, legality, and quality are never inferred from name-only history.
completion.evaluation: The frozen mixed-evidence evaluator requires source, date, uncertainty, a safe next action, and separate attribution of stale or conflicting evidence. It forbids published or centralized local observations and employer, scam, legal, or composite verdicts.
completion.user_experience: Desktop and narrow browser journeys cover current, partial, offline, stale-failure, and missing-source dossier states. Stored evidence remains usable offline, errors are sanitized and retryable, links are bounded, status is conveyed in text, and request identity guards prevent cross-job races.

red_green.initial_red: Fail-first application, storage, domain-evaluator, decoder, component, and browser tests proved the dossier projection, exact-name history, mixed-evidence assertions, bounded renderer contract, and user-visible states were absent before implementation.
red_green.review_red: Independent completion and security reviews found missing privacy ownership, weak provenance and source identity, incomplete decoder bounds, insufficient state coverage, and broad-gate regressions. Each finding received the smallest focused regression and correction before the full gate.
red_green.green: Focused owner tests, the mixed-evidence evaluator, full browser budget, all-features Rust workspace, and exact-revision full repository gate passed.
